status_at_lock: No held-out model evaluation has occurred. Subsequent results must not change this selection.
deployment_mode: Explicit trusted controller enables adapter for temporal choices; ordinary requests disable it on the same base model.
selection_reason: Best observed development pair accuracy and item accuracy (128/128 pairs; 256/256 items), with original base preserved through explicit routing. Step 600 scored lower. Active ordinary generation still fails arithmetic and is rejected for always-on use.

development_retention.ordinary_generation: Sky and greeting are coherent; arithmetic 17+25 returns 17. This is a known active-adapter failure, not a pass.

evaluation.primary_comparison: Original base and selected adapter on identical clock-feature prompts.
evaluation.frozen_head_control: Train on the same 1024 curriculum cases with clock features; fixed existing head algorithm; reuse head on test without refitting.
evaluation.shuffled_label_control: Identical selected-run training configuration except --shuffle-labels; evaluate checkpoint480 regardless of control dev scores.
secondary_conditions: Selected adapter and base on raw inputs (explicit view mismatch for adapter)
evaluation.uncertainty: 10000 bootstrap draws over complete counterfactual pairs, seed1103. Synthetic sample variability only, not training-seed or real-world uncertainty.
evaluation.provisional_success_bar: At least70% both-correct pair accuracy and at least20 percentage points better than identical-input base. Chosen after dev but before test, not an original preregistration.

live_protocol: Five actual monotonic-clock snapshots: before silence threshold, after threshold, new observation, cancellation during inference, refreshed cancellation. Report snapshot correctness and deterministic publication guard separately. Use --gated and clock-features.
language_preservation_check: Re-run real gated parity on this selected checkpoint. Disabled-mode logits and greedy strings must match the original on the three fixed ordinary prompts; base tensor identity must be shared. This is a routing guarantee for this implementation, not broad active-model retention.
limits: Train augmentation overlaps broad numerical ranges
No TimesFM or 17M decision-model weight fusion in this intervention
Deterministic rules solve these tasks without a language model
